why: A mandate that lives only in a chat message is a preference: nothing fails when it is violated, and context compaction erases it. This file makes the role split machine-readable so a gate can refuse work that bypassed its lane.

PLAN.evidence: a receipts/dispatch/PLAN*.json with ok=true and nonce_present=true

EXECUTE.evidence: a receipts/dispatch/EXECUTE*.json with ok=true and nonce_present=true
EXECUTE.substitution: Owner order 2026-10-23: minimax-m3.1-flash-free returns 410 Gone (deprecated at provider); EXECUTE is rebound to opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash at rank 1.

VERIFY.actor: SBL-Acceptance Challenge & Independent Acceptance Officer & VERIFY & SECURITY
VERIFY.evidence: a receipts/dispatch/VERIFY*.json with ok=true and nonce_present=true

violation_policy: a work item whose role is in a role above may not be marked DONE without the matching receipt; the gate exits non-zero and names the item
honest_ceiling: This makes violation detectable and blocking. It cannot make a model obey; it can make disobedience unshippable.

repair_class_rule.execute_required: every product-semantic change: source, tests, fixtures, workflow semantics, specs. EXECUTE authors exact patches against a frozen base digest; it need not spawn tests.
orchestrator_allowed: write governance records (queue, ledger, TT, FAR provenance)
edit round tooling only with a test in the same commit
repair_class_rule.evidence: an orchestrator-applied patch records the EXECUTE receipt and the base digest; an orchestrator-authored product change must be marked lane_bypassed and stays a blocker until EXECUTE re-authors it
repair_class_rule.ruled_by: owner standing order 2026-10-23 (executed by the agent, not signed)
repair_class_rule.consequence_for_today: Q9 and Q12 remain bypassed because their edits changed acceptance meaning; Q17/Q18/Q19 are plumbing under this rule and are recorded, not laundered
